page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores with 48 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, and the absence of dedicated GPUs limits its utility for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory-to-core ratio position this instance for memory-intensive workloads that require predictable compute performance without hyperthreading overhead. It is configured for workloads such as in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing applications.
